provenance.mode: new source generation using inspected references
provenance.copy_method: PowerShell Copy-Item; untouched PNG; original retained

references.role: retro pixel style only; noncanonical labels and props ignored

image.transparency: Actual alpha present; transparent pixels and substantial partial alpha preserved unchanged.

source_size_review.method: Visual inspection of generated original and byte-identical copied source with view_image; full-resolution alpha census and SHA256 comparison.
observations: All 32 full-body sprites present in four rows of eight; no gross grid omission, clipped extremity or overlapping character.
Expected front, front-right, right profile, back-right, back, back-left, left profile, front-left sequence visually present in each row.
Broad leafy woodbody identity, twig crown, amber-eyed bark face, green mantle/leaf panels, gold buckle, mossy segmented stone gauntlets and root-toed feet retained.
Hands remain empty within stone gauntlets; no hammer, held prop, environment, text, labels or effects.
Rising row has knees folded and root feet tucked with gauntlets lifted outward; descent extends legs downward and lowers/opens the gauntlets.
Landing has a visibly lower body and deeper bend than anticipation; head/crown dimensions appear consistent at source review.
Rear facing hands are partly naturally occluded. Front-quarter descent poses use mildly asymmetric legs.
limitations: This is source-size visual review, not native-scale or runtime acceptance.
Exact skull, limb-volume and root-registration consistency has not been measured at target pixel scale.
Some descending views have one foot slightly higher or farther forward; final small-scale feet-ready readability requires lead review.
Uniform generated grid intent does not guarantee exact deterministic cell registration. Source width and height are not integer multiples of eight and four, respectively.
Substantial partial alpha requires lead-owned deterministic cleanup; no cleanup, downsampling, mirroring, code painting or registration was performed.
Four authored key poses are not complete animation cycles; timing and transition quality are unverified.
